I added a log line to `refund()` in `src/billing/refunds.py`. It records the invoice id and runs after the amount check passes, just before the function returns:

```python
log.info("invoice_refunded", invoice_id=invoice.id)
```

It follows the project's logging rule: use structlog (never Python's built-in `logging` module), name events in snake_case, and put ids in keyword fields rather than the message. I set up the logger with `log = structlog.get_logger()` at the top of the file, the same way `src/billing/invoices.py` does. I haven't run any tests.

If you also want the refund amount in the log, you could add `refunded_cents=amount_cents` to the call.
